physical_interpretation: At fixed hydrogen nuclei, CH4/NH3 add carbon/nitrogen mass and lower thermal speed. Their columns cannot be obtained by changing only molecular count.

A molecular compound released into closed channels can be dissociated/separated before return. Cavity-emitted molecules require physical ambient cleanup, whose ionization and final transfer differ fromHe.
CH4 carbon is a transfer from retained carbon inventory, not automatically a fresh-carbon debit. The same applies to nitrogen inNH3/N2.
Chemical-form fractions, release populations and species-dependent capture are unmeasured here; the tables expose the threshold for a subsequent chemistry test.
The formulas describe a steady diffuse reservoir. They neither bound directed molecular plumes nor solve high-energy reflected CNO atoms.
Atomic molecular-binding mass defects are neglected relative to atomic masses; this is negligible for the column threshold.
